units.source_text: 红日高升之时，两人各各上殿见驾。

en.t: When the red sun had risen high, the two men each went up to the palace to attend upon the emperor.

units.source_text: 源氏公子装出端庄严肃、若无其事的样子。

en.t: Prince Genji put on a grave and dignified air, as though nothing at all had happened.
The Captain, however, was secretly laughing to himself.

units.source_text: 这一天正值公事烦忙，有种种政务奏请敕裁。

en.t: That day happened to be crowded with official business, and many affairs of state were submitted for imperial decision.

units.source_text: 两人訚訚侃侃，神气活现。

en.t: The two spoke with ease and confidence, looking perfectly composed and full of spirit.

units.source_text: 有时视线相接，各自低头微笑。

en.t: At times their eyes met, and each lowered his head with a faint smile.

units.source_text: 偶值无人在旁，头中将便走近源氏公子去，向他白一眼，恨恨地说：“你死守秘密，如今再敢不敢？”

en.t: Whenever no one happened to be nearby, the Captain would step close to Prince Genji, glare at him, and say resentfully, "You kept your secret to the end. Would you dare do it again now?"

units.source_text: 源氏公子答道：“哪里的话！

en.t: Prince Genji answered, "What are you talking about!

units.source_text: 特地来了空手归去的人，才是倒霉的！

en.t: The unlucky one is the man who came all this way only to go home empty-handed!

units.source_text: 老实告诉你：人言可畏，我不得不如此呀。”

en.t: To tell you the truth, gossip is frightening, so I had no choice but to act as I did."

units.source_text: 两人交谈了一会，相约要与古歌“若有人问答不知”[\[24\]](#part1336.html#m24)一样，大家严守秘密。

en.t: After talking for a while, the two agreed that, like the old poem saying, "If anyone asks, answer that you do not know"[\[24\]](#part1336.html#m24), they would both keep the secret strictly.
